attrs.evidence_class_text: TESTED under the exact stated profile (GPT v3 §12) — first real adapter run; falsify-then-repair: the naive adapter duplicates, the keyed far side deduplicates; two crash classes; reconciliation by far-side evidence, attempt-aware after a key-only first run mis-attributed
attrs.name: S5 external-effect honesty, first real adapter run: ampd Gateway.perform/5 + a KEYED git far side (create-if-absent by idempotency key) vs a NAIVE far side (append). Process crash after the far side applied the effect → ATTEMPTED as written → recover! → UNKNOWN + reconcile queue → re-claim refused by name; a re-authorized replay is DEDUPLICATED by the keyed far side (already-applied) and DUPLICATED by the naive one (2 ledger commits, both COMMITTED in the journal); crash before the effect → UNKNOWN whose reconciliation finds nothing; SIGKILL of the BEAM → no seal, boot-time recover! → UNKNOWN; reconciliation resolves by the far side's own record, attempt-aware
